name: National Aluminium Co. Ltd.
about: National Aluminium Company Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of alumina and aluminum products in India and internationally. The company operates through Chemical and Aluminum segments. It offers aluminum metal products, such as ingots, alloy ingots, T-ingots, sows, billets, and wire rods; alumina and hydrate products, including calcined alumina and alumina hydrate; zeolite-A products; specialty alumina and hydrate products; and aluminum rolled and chequered sheets products. verdict.label: Looks cheap
reasons: Price implies only ~-3% a year growth, below the ~8% that history and analysts support, so expectations look modest.
PE of 8 is near the bottom of its range over the last 3 years (median 13), though that is a short history to judge by.
Trades at PE 8 vs a quality-and-growth-justified 13 for this sector; cheaper than peers of similar quality.
Since 2023, the price gain has been earned: earnings grew 59% a year while PE moved 11 → 8.
